summary: Revision 5 keeps the authorized five-family scope, accepted Button definitions, source-first design-spec gate, and later rendered Light/Dark checks. The registered plan, contract, and design-document hashes match the current files. NavigationItem's four per-variant behavior records now agree: default, hover, and unselected focus use weight 500; selected uses 700; focus preserves the underlying state's weight. The per-variant selectedCue describes the 700-versus-500 cue, and the family contract specifies the same numeric weights. The Dark hover alias resolves to canvas and selected to surface.subtle; actual distinction against the current Figma parent and selected+focus presentation still require the planned visual check. This plan pass does not approve Figma work by itself: the current source bundle needs a fresh independent design-spec pass and successful handoff before projection. Runtime interaction and accessibility claims remain outside this document review.
